correctness.rationale: On Q4 with 16 labeled binary vertices, exhaustive direct independent enumeration of all subsets k=1,...,6 proved zero connected dominating sets for k<6 and exactly 192 of size6, all induced P6. All 192 optimum sets arise from direction words (a,b,c,d,a); source verify_group.py independently builds connected subsets and a free transitive 192-element affine-even-permutation group action on the state set. Exhaustive one-vertex replacements give degree4 and 384 jump edges; zero replacements use a cube-adjacent moved token, so slide exchange graph is empty. The four displayed H=F2^4⋊A4 generators act as all neighbors and give an inverse-closed Cayley graph; BFS distance levels (1,4,10,23,45,76,30,3) show diameter7 and connectedness. Independent reimplementation directly rebuilt state jump graph and parity-double BFS, obtaining odd girth11, matching source group method and explicit 11-letter odd identity word. This is exhaustive for Q4 only; no higher-dimensional extrapolation.

value.rationale: Q4 is a natural canonical finite hypercube, and minimum connected dominating sets are optimal connected coverage backbones. An exact classification of their reconfiguration graph, affine regular action, diameter, shortest odd cycle, and obstruction to all local token slides exposes meaningful reachability/dynamics structure, not just an arbitrary catalogued integer. The contrast that all optimal states are connected by jumps within seven steps but isolated by slides is a motivated qualitative boundary.
